title: Module 4 Design Draft Clinic
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting module 4 design draft clinic to the prioritized evidence-ranked revision plan, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Synthesize the module's artifacts (problem statement, load diagnosis, accessibility pass, traceability) into one plan.
Rank revisions by evidenced impact on the problem statement's named outcome.
Filter generic AI critique down to claims you can substantiate against your own evidence.
Defend a prioritization, not just a list of changes.
